mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signals a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), strong hiring and consumer spending drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: In periods of high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive SPX 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1100.0 thousand units signal weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth above 2.0% and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually), inflation concerns and potential rate hikes lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually)
failure_condition: In periods of late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% indicates a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
